summary: Stepan Company filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting Q2 results and a board-approved workforce reduction of ~100 salaried roles as part of Project Catalyst. The plan, approved July 28, 2026, is expected to incur $4-6 million in severance and related charges, with the majority recognized in H2 2026. Full-year Project Catalyst restructuring charges are estimated at $75-80 million, mostly cash. Separately, director Jan Stern Reed resigned effective July 27, 2026. The filing signals ongoing cost restructuring, with potential additional charges, though no deal terms or premium are present.
